wargear.name: Blizzard Shield
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable save and gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

wargear.name: Belts of Russ
wargear.text: A model with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Wolf Tail Talisman
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains the Indomitable Spirit (6+) special rule.

wargear.name: Thunderwolf Cavalry
wargear.text: A model with this wargear becomes the Cavalry type. In addition, the equipped model gains +1 to their Strength (S), Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) characteristics. The equipped model also gains 1 additional Close Combat Weapon.

wargear.name: Runic Armour
wargear.text: This wargear confers a 2+ Armour Save and the Indomitable Spirit (5+) special rule.

wargear.name: The Armour of Russ
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains a 2+ Save. In addition, all enemy units within 3" of a model equipped with this Relic in the Combat Phase suffer -1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic.

wargear.name: The Helm of Durfast
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Linked special rule on all equipped Shooting Weapons. In addition, the bearer and any attached unit gain the Ignores Cover special rule on their equipped Shooting Weapons.

wargear.name: The Wulfen Stone
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Curse of the Wulfen special rule.

wargear.name: Pelt of the Balewolf
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Fear (3) special rule.

wargear.name: The Mountain Breaker Helm
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Hammer of Wrath (1) special rule. This does not stack with other Hammer of Wrath (x) special rules even when noted. However, the bearers Hammer of Wrath Attacks are resolved at Strength 10.

wargear.name: The Storm's Eye
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character & Psyker (x) special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic may re-roll 1 dice when making a Psychic Test.

wargear.name: Storm Rider
wargear.text: A model with this wargear becomes the Cavalry type. In addition, it gains a Close Combat Weapon.

wargear.name: Wolf Amulet
wargear.text: This model has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Wolf Helm of Russ
wargear.text: This unit and any attached unit automatically pass all Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, when calculating wounds for determining who won combat, if the unit equipped with this wargear took part in the combat, add 1 to the number of wounds inflicted by the space wolves for calculating who won combat.

wargear.name: Healing Balms
wargear.text: A model with this wargear and any attached unit gain the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

wargear.name: Pelt of the Doppelgangrel
wargear.text: Enemy attacks in the Combat Phase have -1 to hit this unit. If this unit is attached to another unit, wounds cannot be allocated to this unit via the Precision Hits special rule.
